scope: Real isolated PostgreSQL; player events, inventory removal receipts and depleted-treasury state are explicit fixtures, no real wallets or Minecraft inventory/payment proof

checks.name: one-time starter grants and durable join retries
payment preview does not spend and another player cannot confirm
confirmed transfer conserves coins and repeated confirmations pay zero extra
immutable operation binding, whole positive amounts and overdraft checks
confirmation rechecks available funds and no unsupported paid jobs are invented
finite shop funding is seeded once and sale preparation holds coins without paying
owner-only sale retry returns original immutable inventory target and operation without grants
only an exact bound removal receipt settles a sale and receipt replay pays zero extra
confirmed no-removal cancellation releases only its hold and combined coin supply is conserved
unfunded or unsupported sales never authorize inventory removal
